# Forest

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-forest)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-forest)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-forest)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-forest)

Forest is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-forest codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `forest` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { forest } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-forest';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, forest],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `forest` | `Extension` |
| `forestMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#1a2a33` |
| Active line | `#233439` |
| Selection | `#244537` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#a9d3ab` | bold | 8.85:1 | 7.76:1 | 6.36:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#a9d3ab` | bold | 8.85:1 | 7.76:1 | 6.36:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#de8aed` | - | 6.30:1 | 5.53:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#de8aed` | - | 6.30:1 | 5.53:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#51baaf` | - | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#7caee0` | - | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#7caee0` | - | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#9ccc65` | - | 7.90:1 | 6.93:1 | 5.67:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#ffb74d` | - | 8.53:1 | 7.48:1 | 6.12:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#ffb74d` | italic | 8.53:1 | 7.48:1 | 6.12:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#51baaf` | italic | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.54:1 |
| String | `string` | `#fd887f` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#fd887f` | - | 6.33:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#cfa17b` | - | 6.35:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#cfa17b` | - | 6.35:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#51baaf` | - | 6.32:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#8faebd` | italic | 6.29:1 | 5.52:1 | 4.52:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#d0d8e0` | background, active line, selection | 7.36:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#7c9aa8` | gutter | 4.54:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#c594c5` | background, active line | 5.19:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#ffb74d` | background | 8.53:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #ffb74d80` | background, active line | 3.01:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#42855c, 1px solid #ffb74d90` | background (fill or outline) | 3.69:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#2c5a3a92` | active line | 1.22:1 | Pass |
